How to use Express Union NEXT

For Express Union's founder and teams, and for anyone who wants to see how a money-transfer network could serve its customers in an app, in their chats and at the agency.

Open Express Union NEXT ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to express-union-next.vercel.app.

2

FR and EN at the top switch the language.

3

Click Discover the experience for the guided presentation, or Explore the app to use the customer app as Aïcha.

4

Click Try it on WhatsApp to open the chat simulator, then tap a menu number or write a sentence such as send 5000 to an MTN number.

5

The demo PIN is 1234. Money, people and phone numbers are fictitious.

6

The user guide and the book are under Guide & book on the home page, as PDF.

02

Features

01

The Express Union number on WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS

For customers who will never install an app: a numbered menu, buttons and receipts in the chat, and commands in one sentence. The PIN is never typed in the conversation; it goes into a secure window, or a USSD-style prompt on SMS. A virtual receptionist answers questions, books appointments and hands over to a person.

STEPS

  1. Open Try it on WhatsApp
  2. Tap a menu number or write a sentence
  3. Confirm in the secure window with the PIN
02

Send to any number

The Express Union directory is checked first, then the operator is detected from the number, MTN or Orange. The recipient's name is shown before sending, a new recipient raises a warning, and the fee appears on the summary before the PIN. Every transfer gets a receipt, and the diaspora can send from euros, dollars or pounds.

STEPS

  1. Open Send
  2. Enter the amount and the number
  3. Check the name and the fee, then confirm
03

My agent

The agent takes on repeated tasks: monthly support to a parent, a savings rule on salary day, a bill to pay. It proposes, the customer confirms, and each task can be paused or stopped from the app or from the chat.

STEPS

  1. Open My agent
  2. Create a task or accept a proposal
  3. Pause or stop it at any time
04

Community money

Tontines keep their social rules and gain a clear record: members, order of rounds, contributions, lateness and payout. Collections, group gifts, paid groups and payment pages for creators and freelancers sit in the same space.

STEPS

  1. Open Community
  2. Open a tontine to see rounds and members
  3. Pay the round with your PIN
05

Mutual aid

People ask for help and others give to help. Requests are checked before money is withdrawn, stories copied from another request are flagged, and anyone can report a request for review by the administration.

STEPS

  1. Open Entraide
  2. Read a request and its checks
  3. Give, or report the request
06

Developers

A sandbox API in the browser: apps with scoped keys shown once, an Idempotency-Key that makes a repeated payment harmless, a limit of 60 requests a minute and signed webhooks, with a console and logs.

STEPS

  1. Open Developers
  2. Create a sandbox app and its key
  3. Send a first request from the console
07

The presentation

Sixteen scenes for the founder, from the network Express Union already has to the next generation, with speaker notes and live screens of the demo.

STEPS

  1. Click Discover the experience
  2. Move with the arrows or the keyboard
  3. Open the notes for what to say
08

The guide and the book

Two full-colour PDFs in French with the real screens of the app: the complete user guide, 155 pages, and Le guichet dans la poche, 208 pages, on why the project matters for Cameroon, Central Africa and the diaspora.

STEPS

  1. Open Guide & book on the home page
  2. Read it in the browser
  3. Download the PDF
03Tips
  • Present with two tabs: the customer app in one and the agency or merchant console in the other; both share the same ledger.
  • Reset the demo from the demo panel before a presentation to start from the original data.
  • Everything runs in the browser: no account to create, no real money, nothing sent to a real network.
04FAQ
Is this an Express Union service?

No. It is a concept proposed to Express Union's founder, with simulated money and fictitious people. A real launch would need Express Union's systems, licences and approvals.

Can the agent move money on its own?

No. The agent prepares; every operation ends with a summary and the customer's PIN.

Do MTN and Orange really work?

They are simulated: the operator is detected from the number and the name check is simulated. A real service would connect through the regional interoperability network and the operators' APIs.

Where are the guide and the book?

On the home page under Guide & book, as PDF, in French.

Which languages?

French and English for the app; the guide and the book are in French.
